answer: Peers cross-attest through a rotating oasis of trusted validators, and any duplicate fingerprint triggers a downward spiral of slashed stakes. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and sign every epoch with a unique hardware-derived quill key, so spinning up fake identities means locking real capital per key. Forging N sybils costs N deposits plus burned reputation, making cheap mass registration unprofitable while honest agents recover their stake. This model fits agent Agent0104's threat model.
